title: Per-request service/client construction
summary: Rails controllers or middleware construct expensive clients or configuration objects on every request.
rationale: Repeated construction adds allocation churn and latency across all requests touching that path.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Reuse thread-safe clients, memoize stable configuration, and avoid global mutable state.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
